summary: An RN-led Yorkville clinic since 2011 with Google reviews, but every main booking button on the homepage links to nothing.

findings.problem: Book Now, Book Consultation and Schedule an appointment all link to #, in the header and the footer.
findings.cost: Every booking button is dead, so ready clients cannot book from the page.
findings.fix: Booking buttons linked to your booking system.

findings.problem: System messages (Your message was sent successfully! and Something went wrong, try refreshing) appear in several places, and a stray x shows near the top.
findings.cost: Leftover messages make the site look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean forms with messages shown only after sending.

findings.problem: Typos and mismatches include Scollard Str., Crows Feet, MedVSpa and MedVSPA, and Lymph Drainage against Lymphatic Drainage.
findings.cost: Small errors reduce trust in a medical clinic.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one brand spelling.

findings.problem: Before and After is a single teaser image with a link, reviews name Elena in one place and Olena in another, and there is no WhatsApp option.
findings.cost: Clients want results and a quick way to ask.
findings.fix: A before and after gallery, a named team and a messaging option.

redesign: Working booking buttons on every page.
A results gallery, consistent names and a simple messaging option.
